query: How do I install corner guards for child safety?

goal.title: Install adhesive corner guards on a furniture corner
goal.description: Wipe down a furniture corner with a cloth to prepare the surface, then peel the paper backing off roughly a dozen small clear adhesive corner guards one at a time. Hold up a guard to check it, then press each corner guard firmly onto a corner of the furniture frame in a repeated sequence of short presses, working around to a new corner guard and corner about ten times, with one brief pause to reach into a nearby drawer partway through.
goal.final_state: Roughly ten small clear corner guards have been pressed onto corners of the furniture frame; the last guard is still being pressed into place as the video ends, with peeled paper backings scattered on the desk nearby.
procedure: Wipe the surface near the furniture corner.
Peel adhesive backing and inspect the small clear pieces.
Press the first adhesive pieces into position along the furniture edges.
Continue peeling and pressing additional pieces at successive positions.
Press the remaining pieces into place and check their contact with the surface.

phases.description: Wipe the furniture corner clean with a cloth.
Peel the paper backing off about a dozen individual corner guards.
Hold up a corner guard to inspect it before applying it.
Press a sequence of corner guards firmly onto corners of the furniture frame, one after another.

notes: This video is dominated by a single repeated micro-action: the human fine-track splits one continuous 'press the corner guard onto the furniture corner' motion into roughly 90 sub-second segments (many 0.1s long) across about ten corner-guard applications, interspersed with a few longer press segments and occasional brief re-peels of another guard's backing. All of these were reviewed via dense and sparse contact sheets; the pressing motion and held object are visually consistent throughout, so steps within each press cluster share the same description by design (flagged as repeated-summary warnings, not errors) rather than inventing false visual distinctions. Step 32 (105.3-105.4s, 0.1s) is labeled in the source as 'hand reaches into drawer', an outlier amid the pressing sequence; it is kept as a brief, low-confidence reach rather than reinterpreted as another press. The exact furniture piece is not identified from the frames (a reflective metal-framed item, possibly a lamp base or small stand, sits beside the work area but is not clearly the object receiving the guards), so it is tracked generically as 'furniture corner'. Fine track ends 9.93s before ffprobe_duration (165.134s); this is a large gap but no additional source segments cover it, so no step was added per the no-alter-boundaries rule - the gap is flagged here per the tail-note requirement.

coarse.description: Wipe down the furniture corner with a cloth to prepare it for the corner guards.
coarse.goal_contribution: Prepares the receiving surface for adhesive contact.

coarse.description: Peel the paper backing off about a dozen corner guards and hold one up to inspect it.
coarse.goal_contribution: Exposes adhesive and readies a piece for placement.
coarse.predictability_reason: The cleaned furniture corners are ready for adhesive guard preparation.

coarse.description: Press the first four corner guards firmly onto corners of the furniture frame, including a brief reach toward a nearby drawer.
coarse.goal_contribution: Begins attaching the protective pieces to the furniture edges.
coarse.predictability_reason: Peeled guards are ready to apply.

coarse.description: Continue pressing three more corner guards onto successive corners of the furniture frame.
coarse.goal_contribution: Extends the adhesive protection to additional edge positions.
coarse.predictability_reason: After initial guards, additional corners still need coverage.

coarse.description: Press the final four corner guards into place, finishing with the last guard still being pressed as the video ends.
coarse.goal_contribution: Continues securing the remaining pieces; the track ends during the final application.
coarse.predictability_reason: Remaining corners naturally receive the final guards.
